Lake life comes home with you

Rowlett is a lake town. It sits on the shore of Lake Ray Hubbard, with Lakeview Parkway running through the middle of it, the George Bush Turnpike and I-30 for the drive to work, and the DART Blue Line ending at Downtown Rowlett. People move here for the water, the space and the easy access to Dallas.

Lake living has its own kind of mess. Wet towels, sandy shoes, dogs that went swimming and a back door that never stays closed for long. Our house cleaning in Rowlett, TX is built for real, lived-in homes like that. We're based in Richardson, and Rowlett is an easy drive east on the turnpike.

"Everything looked spotless, organized, and professionally handled. If you want someone you can trust to keep your space looking its best, Lindsey is the one. Highly recommend!" — M. Proctor

Cleaning services for Rowlett homes

  • Recurring cleaning: weekly, every other week or monthly, so the sand and dog hair never pile up. For a limited time, recurring clients get a reduced rate on every visit.
  • Deep cleaning: bathroom cleaning that tackles soap scum and grout, baseboard cleaning, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), and appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge.
  • Standard cleaning: the everyday essentials.
  • Move-in / move-out cleaning: for buyers, sellers and renters.
  • Pet-friendly house cleaning: for homes where the dog has the run of the place.
  • Airbnb and short-term rental cleaning: turnovers scheduled around your guests' checkout and check-in.
  • Post-construction cleaning: for remodels and updates.

Also available: one-time cleaning before a holiday or a weekend of guests.

Dogs welcome, wet paws and all

If your dog thinks the lake is a bathtub, you already know where the mud ends up. We're pet-friendly, we work calmly around your animals, and we use eco-friendly, pet-safe products. Tell us about your pets in the booking form, and we'll give extra attention to the floors by the back door and the hair on the rugs.

The Rowlett cleaning checklist

Kitchen: counters, backsplash, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors, microwave and cabinet fronts

Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, glass, mirrors, sinks and fixtures cleaned and sanitized

Living areas and bedrooms: dusting, mirrors and glass, beds made, trash emptied

Floors: vacuumed and mopped, with extra care at entryways

Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge; move-in/move-out cleans also add door frames, inside vanities and closet shelving
